entry.name: teamonup
entry.description: TeamOnUP is an employee experience platform that recaptures value for companies by enabling access to growth on purpose for each employee. Our platform is end-user designed and driven to transform your workplace to a digital experience that your internal customers - your employees - have come to expect in our digital world. TeamOnUP: - Allows employees to create and champion goals - Provides assessment tools for each employee perform a complete inventory of themselves and quantify worklife balance - Enables managers and teams to align on goals that matter for daily work and career success - Customizes to the organization in real-time and ongoing to receive cognitive datasets that drive actionable insights - Assess employee financial and engagement benchmarks to peers inside and outside the organization
